description: Canonical requirement registry. Maps functional/non-functional/business/architectural requirements to source modules, test files, and originating Paperclip issues. Consumed by scripts/lock_module_verify.py, scripts/validate_requirements_registry.py, and scripts/sync_trace_test_cases.py to enforce lock-gate, impact-gate, and gap-detection in CI.

requirements.title: RecoveryProtocol must fetch missing outage data via LakeAPI and replay signals (FDR-003)
requirements.description: Implements ITM Spec §22.3 steps 3 and 4 inside RecoveryProtocol.run(). When state recovery encounters a checkpoint older than max_recovery_age_hours, RecoveryProtocol must (a) fetch missing bars for the outage window from LakeAPI via the optional lakeapi_fetcher callable and (b) replay signals for the offline period via the optional signal_replayer callable. End-to-end recovery for a <=24h outage must complete in under 2 minutes. BTE-TC-FDR-003-A covers these acceptance criteria in tests/itm/state/test_recovery.py::TestFdrTC003A.
